notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40571956/ca4954ff1186270b92bf3c930c068641ce4e4fb8.png[/img]
Dear friends, Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays! We thank you once again and wish you all the best!
We want to bring you the happy news that next year we plan to release about 4 projects, which are now in the process of active development. Among them is, of course, everyone's favorite Find All.  And also we take part in the Steam Next Fest with our new the game CatBox.
P.s Find all planned two parts! :3

notes.title: Hurry up and play Find All 4: Magic (DEMO)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059228/e7bed7bdb9eb7036d335e5fc276f899db5823066.png[/img]
We are pleased to announce the release of the demo version of Find All 4: Magic. The new part of the game is made on the basis of previous experience and your suggestions. Thank you for your support!
In the demo version you will find 190 search items and 2 puzzles.

At the moment there will be only three languages in the Demo version, but in the main version of the game there will be many more!)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2260670/?=2d

notes.title: ToriDori's new game participates in the festival!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059228/003ba05dfddfd54511be272ded5e31d14b590d31.png[/img] Hello! Our new game is participating in the festival. Since our team is gradually expanding, we decided to try ourselves in 3D and in the genre of finding differences, but with its own features. Of course, we don't forget about the Find All series. notes.title: FIND ALL 3: Travel
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40571956/c41fb0a4cdaadb564642ab0191543688b7cd69b9.png[/img]
Embark on a journey through a fascinating, hand-drawn world to find all the hidden cats, raccoons, birds and many more different items.
By finding lost items you will color this world.

Game Features:
- Over 1500 different items to find
- different levels
- Difficulty levels
- Search both outside and inside
- A train! :)
- Level Coloring
- 2.5D effect

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961520/FIND_ALL_3_Travel/
